indirect_reasons: peercontent reports his global napalm team-damage amp was removed, but it is not in these notes — treat as unverified and low-confidence.
Burn AoE still clears the new grouped, chasing Haunt camps, so farm routes partly offset any loss.
heroes.one_liner: No notes change, but the community has him sliding — verify the napalm team-buff rumor before trusting it.

indirect_reasons: Storm Cloud/Static Charge AoE clears the new stacked, chasing Haunt camps faster than almost anyone, and ability-range Buff Containers scale that AoE.
No comeback valve still caps his farm-then-scale line, but the snapshot shows 55.0% WR.
build_changes: Farm-core (Monster Rounds/Cultist Sacrifice) is more valuable: clear stacked camps then run crate routes.
heroes.one_liner: Best AoE jungle clearer in a patch built around stacked camps — his farm lead converts faster.

indirect_reasons: New roofs/high ground let her hold lanes and poke into the Plaza (5-8 min) and Bell Tower fights; the flyer tax (Weighted Bola, air-drag slows) is already priced into her A.
heroes.one_liner: Holds lanes from the new roofs and pokes every hub fight, but still pays the flyer tax.

indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline archetype up: harder-hitting camps reward her regen/sustain stack, and Buff-Container Spirit Resist adds free defense.
Her spirit-caster rivals Celeste and Pocket are still falling, clearing her slot.
heroes.one_liner: Regen bruiser that out-sustains the harder camps — quietly climbing the front-line slot.

indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline up, and his melee core gives cheap heavy-melee access to Tough Crates (58 souls each), the patch's best farm route.
Parry-vs-objective change makes diving him under tower riskier for the enemy.
heroes.one_liner: Melee frontline that can farm the new heavy crates as fast as anyone — quietly stronger.
Nothing in the patch touches her — still a B gun carry leaning pure gun.

indirect_reasons: Turrets/wall zone the contested hub fights and defend against the now-punishable dives (parry-cooldown change); more spread vaults reward her siege.
Turrets also help clear stacked camps.
heroes.one_liner: Zone controller whose turret/wall setup fits the telegraphed hub fights and punishes dives.

indirect_reasons: New districts, hiding spots and Steam-Vent invisibility upgrade her roamer/pick setups; peercontent puts her ahead of Bebop in that slot.
heroes.one_liner: The annoying-roamer slot is more viable with more hiding spots — she's ahead of Bebop now.

indirect_reasons: Telegraphed hub fights (Plaza, Bell Tower) give Singularity clean setup windows, and his initiator items went untouched.
Offset: his durable-frontline counters (Krill) are rising.
heroes.one_liner: Singularity loves the new forced hub fights — still the default tempo initiator.

indirect_reasons: Harder-hitting camps make his dome/sustain more valuable, and the snapshot's 54.2% WR supports it.
Healing Snacks (10% max HP) and trimmed healing items slightly cheapen dedicated healing.
heroes.one_liner: Sustain pick for the higher camp damage — peercontent calls him stable, the WR says strong.
Unchanged by the patch; her farm-carry role is meta-driven, not identity.

indirect_reasons: New districts, hiding spots and Steam-Vent invisibility expand her roam/pick routes; Bell Tower hub fights reward her lasso picks.
heroes.one_liner: Mobile pick assassin built for the new hiding-spot, hub-fight map.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: the roamer slot is more viable but Paradox has moved ahead of him, and his single-target hook converts less into a farm-and-sustain economy.
heroes.one_liner: Same roamer slot as Paradox, now the lower-priority option.

indirect_reasons: Tough Crates — the patch's dominant farm route — need a Heavy Melee, which forces her out of cat form and locks her out of that economy; peercontent has her unpicked in DNS.
Offset: the tempo meta still suits her dives.
build_changes: Cannot run the box-route economy efficiently; lean harder on kills/off-map gold and delay farm-heavy openings.
heroes.one_liner: Cat form locks her out of the new heavy-crate farm — the patch's one real black mark on her.
Nothing new for him this patch — still a C poke flyer paying the anti-air tax.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: the camp/uptime meta favors sustained front lines and he takes Billy's front-line slot; tank archetype up.
With two points in T3 bullet resist he is one of the few that can still dive towers after the parry-cooldown change.
heroes.one_liner: Billy's fall hands him the front-line slot — the default sustained tank now.

indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline up means more big-HP targets for current-HP Serrated Knives; harder camps reward his regen sustain.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-tank that eats the rising frontline wave — quietly the best tank-killer.

indirect_reasons: peercontent floats her up on camp-damage sustain (low-confidence); Healing Snacks and trimmed healing items cut both ways for a healer.
heroes.one_liner: Sustain option for the harder camps, but the healing-item trims muddy her heal identity.

indirect_reasons: Late-scaler gun carry in the early-close economy with no comeback valve; his Shadow Weave invis-engage gains little from Steam Vents relative to roamers.
heroes.one_liner: Still a slow gun scaler the tempo economy refuses to wait for.

direct_reasons: Flying Strike now creates paths against solid targets (turrets, Shrines, objectives), adding mobility and objective access.
indirect_reasons: peercontent: she gathers and punches down the new grouped, chasing Haunt camps faster than almost anyone; the tempo meta rewards her burst.
heroes.one_liner: Camp-clear champion of the patch with a new Flying Strike path — take A toward S.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: green-lane high ground (roof/tree above the bridge) lets him hold lane permanently, and boxes matter more; his dive/stomp snowballs in the no-comeback economy.
heroes.one_liner: Still the highest-pick initiator, now with a lane-roof to farm off.

indirect_reasons: Harder camps reward his Cube sustain, and more spread-out vaults reward his Goo Ball map presence.
heroes.one_liner: Cube sustain helps vs the harder camps; not a headline mover.

indirect_reasons: Late-scaler DoT carry hurt by the tempo/no-comeback read, but his cloak mobility and AoE suit the more mobile, farm-heavy map.
heroes.one_liner: Mobile scaler caught between a friendly map and an unfriendly tempo.

indirect_reasons: More, more widely spread vaults make split-push harder to defend (up), but he is a slow scaler in a tempo economy (down).
heroes.one_liner: Split-push loves the extra vaults; the fast economy doesn't love his slow curve.
Patch-neutral gun carry; her (09-16) item hits are already priced in.
No change touches him — still a draft-dependent coin-flip.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: rises off grouped-camp AoE clear (same dynamic as Yamato), and her mobility suits the new districts.
heroes.one_liner: Camps group and chase — she clears them; her damage problem stays.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: more centers/hiding spots and his stealth-revealing sense favor him in the Steam-Vent layout; heavy-melee crate access and the tank/roamer archetypes are up.
heroes.one_liner: Stealth-friendly map plus a stealth-revealing sense — the roamer who benefits most.

direct_reasons: Graves can now destroy his traps with her gun — a narrow counter, not a balance change.
indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline up and heavy-melee crate access suit his bruiser build; his (09-16) buffs are already priced.
heroes.one_liner: Still the default gun bruiser — only his traps got a new answer.

indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline archetype up: harder camps reward his regen/sustain stack, and the snapshot's 56.4% WR is the second-highest on the board.
heroes.one_liner: Sustain frontline the camp-damage meta feeds — climbing on the numbers.

indirect_reasons: Lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks reward the lane pressure that is her whole identity; the contested hubs suit her carry-snowball.
heroes.one_liner: Wins lane then banks crates and heals — exactly what the patch pays for.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: Bell Tower's single rope up/down plus its ~280 souls makes his Doorway kidnap strong, and the height gap forces pre-placed doors — a build-around.
Offset: the tempo read still punishes his delayed setup.
build_changes: Pre-place a Doorway before roping up to Bell Tower to enable the kidnap.
heroes.one_liner: Bell Tower's single rope makes his kidnap a real objective play.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: he fell off because the camp/farm meta wants more uptime, and his front-line slot went to rising Krill; anti-tank Shiv is still climbing.
heroes.one_liner: Fell off — the meta wants uptime and sustain, so Krill took the front-line slot.

direct_reasons: Can now destroy Venator's traps with her gun (minor utility).
indirect_reasons: Late-scaler split-pusher: spread vaults reward split-push, but no comeback valve hurts her ~25-min line.
Snapshot shows 56.8% WR, directly contradicting the KB's 48.5%-WR C read — flag as unreliable.
heroes.one_liner: Notes say nothing bad; the snapshot's 56.8% WR clashes with the KB — data unresolved.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: roaming pseudo-front-line that farms crates/roams better and, with T3 bullet resist, is one of few still able to dive towers after the parry-cooldown change.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo lane bully that can still tower-dive — the patch's clean archetype winner.

indirect_reasons: peercontent: harder camps reward his sustain and more spread-out vaults (Bell Tower now has three) make his map play stronger; Healing Snacks slightly cheapen dedicated healing.
heroes.one_liner: Rises on a map change, not a buff — harder camps and harder-to-defend vaults.

indirect_reasons: Tank/frontline up suits her gun-tank sustain shell; her anti-air (Weighted Bola) already prices flyers out.
heroes.one_liner: Gun tank the sustain/camp meta feeds; still the flyer answer.

indirect_reasons: peercontent keeps her a winner (fast scaler, camps), but she is a flyer/late-scaler eating the air-drag tax in a tempo economy — mixed.
heroes.one_liner: Creator says still strong; the flyer/late-scaler taxes say held in check.

direct_reasons: Announced as one of six new heroes; released two per week starting Oct 2 in a community-voted order — no kit detail in the notes.
heroes.one_liner: Brand-new hero with no kit read — provisional only.
